properties.w: The White Horde broke up in the 1460s; the Kazakhs, the Nogais and Sibir (drawn from Cliopatria) took most of it. These are the steppe peoples between them, such as the Bashkirs and the Turkmens.
Jurchen tribes, which the Ming counted as its frontier guards, and the Tungusic peoples of the Amur. The Ming ruled only Liaodong.
Unknown to Europeans until 1596 (some read a 1194 Norse saga as an earlier sighting); no state ruled it.
